agendas.name: Pursuit of Knowledge
agendas.description: At battle end, if you have more units in your opponent's deployment zone than they have in yours (excluding Battle-shocked units), select up to 3 THOUSAND SONS units in their deployment zone. Each gains 2XP. Characters among them roll D6: on 2+, gain 1 Lore point.

agendas.name: Malefic Sigils
agendas.description: Each turn, a PSYKER that manifests a power in a table quarter casts a sigil in that quarter. At battle end: if 3 quarters have sigils, each casting PSYKER gains 1XP; if all 4, each gains 1XP and your Warlord gains additional XP. If Warlord gained 2+ XP, re-roll your Plots and Schemes test.

agendas.name: Arcana Long Buried
agendas.description: Before shooting, task a THOUSAND SONS unit to search a controlled objective (no shoot/charge). Success: 2XP (3XP if in opponent's deployment zone). Characters roll D6: on 3+, gain 1 Arcana point. Max 3XP per unit.

agendas.name: Sorcerous Prowess
agendas.description: Each time a PSYKER unit destroys an enemy unit, it gains 1XP (2XP if destroyed by a Psychic attack). Max 3XP per unit. If a Character gained 2+ XP, select it for a free Diabolic Ritual (0RP cost).
